title: There were forty posts on the way up the mountain. Coming down, I counted forty-one
description:
My neighbour ploughed the pass road for forty winters. This winter her chest got bad, her tablets were stuck at the top, and she gave me her keys and one instruction. Count the posts.

On the way up there were forty. On the way down, in the last dark before dawn, one of them was shorter than the rest, as wide as a car, and it had two reflectors.

It's made up. Built with code and Blender.
pin: Would you have kept driving toward the post you could see, or stopped at the one you couldn't explain?
